technical_papers.title: An Smart Aquaponic System Using IoT

details.description:
According to some research institute in less than 5% of sea food is in the state of
collapse and Now by 2050 it is expected that nearly 100% of all the sea food species
may collapse. And as we know the fresh water resources are decline and the world
population is increasing. So, to overcome this problem and to make the world
better place we use aquaponics. Aquaponics is a system that deals with both
aquaculture and hydroponics with this technique utilization of pesticides and water
decreases by 90%. But this to work out properly we need very effective measures to
take. So here we introduce IOT to aquaponics. This paper is based on a concept
which plays a major role in food security and sustainability in many well-developed
countries like Singapore, America. The problem of food scarcity arises due to
modernization and less food production. This paper is an attempt to develop a
smart aquaponics system than can help both fish and plant growing. This is to ensure
a very good healthy environment for fish and plant growing. This project helps in
meeting the food needs and decreasing land usage, manpower, time etc.

organizations.name: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited[Aircraft Research& Design Center]

details.description:
We are a group of three members. A small rotor and electrical component were attached to our RC plane
that was assembled with the help of our professor, and then we tested its flight with our professor.

projects.title: Harvesting electrical energy during the Take-off phase in a flight regime

details.description:
Project Title: Harvesting electrical energy during the Take-off phase in a flight regime, Scope: Vibrations
generated by the Rotor blade of Cessna 172 Aircraft during the initial take-off phase can produce electricity
using piezoelectric sensors. I did this project along with the guidance of Ravi Sing sir. He helped me to
complete this project as early as possible with high accuracy.

projects.title: Interpretation of Super Sonic Airfoil - NACA 66-206

details.description:
here we did a group project of four members on "Interpretation of Super Sonic Airfoil - NACA 66-206 ", I
came to know how to work with a group and on induvial contribution. here we applied concepts of
aerodynamics with the simulations in analyzing the airfoil structures, and flow over the airfoil and we tried
to minimize the drag over the airfoil.

projects.title: Solid State AC Relay With Digital Toggle Switch For Inductive And Resistive Loads

details.description:
Our report aims to study the solid state ac relay with a digital toggle switch for inductive and resistive loads.
Structure and Working Principle of SSRs, Working of Solid State Relay, etc., with PCB Layout, schematic view
of the circuit, and 3D view of our Project.

The proposal is based on the concept of Quad Bike For All Terrain's, where ATVs may be extensively utilised
in government backing for this concept that substitutes two-wheelers since two-wheelers are more
common in accidents. This ATV is recommended for reducing accidents, travelling in forest and steep
terrain, agricultural uses, and military applications.

work_experiences.job_description: I worked under professor Srinivasa Chakravarthy of Computational Neuroscience Lab in IITM, in relation with CONXAI a German architectural startup on 2 projects to use Explainable AI in construction to reduce wastage in the 13.2 Billion architectural Industry and promote sustainability.

As part of the Vision Team on Navigational AR, I worked on a Image segmentation and Lane Detection pipeline, which was implemented in the autonomous and assisted driving module of a car. I had also implemented model changes and modifications to ensure proper functioning, compatibility and speed-up.

details.description: I had worked on 2 projects for the duration of the summer. One was to create algorithmic improvements on the VUS metric - Range based anomaly detection metric, to speed up the execution time be over 5 times. The work when published could be potentially aid in the all the fields involving time series data and could produce major leaps in Healthcare and development.

To pioneer true automation in the field of surgical assistance, while ensuring aspects of safety. We worked with Large Language Models and Reinforcement Learning to simulate and combine multiple surgical settings in various software like SurRoL, AMBFRL and LapGym to emulate a real world scenario.

The project involved generation of pioneer Machine Learning models to replace Chemical Kinetic reaction rate predictions from conventional Computational Fluid Dynamics. This has shown significant speed-up in the lab scale scenario by more than 10 fold, which has prompted industrial implementation of the same.

I am working on Explainable RL for the control setting for my Bachelors project. It uses the concept of explainable Ai to leverage and bring about understanding in the ML techniques used in control theory

technical_papers.title: True automation in Surgical Simulation

details.description: The aim was to create True automation in surgical simulators using LLM. Thus making it more robust and applicable in a variety of simulators and situations thus ensuring safety and security in our shift to Automation and AI.

technical_papers.title: Machine Learning Chemical Kinetic Models

details.description: The work is on using Machine Learning techniques to speed up the Chemical Kinetic rate predictions. This was implemented for Biomass gasification in a Fluidized bed reaction where it showed a speed up of beyond 10X, which has motivated large scale implementation of the same.

Developed a Python program that interprets a star's Target Pixel File's data to generate graphs plotting the star's brightness which indicates the presence of planets if any. The analysis of star's brightness forming light curves is called Transit Method

projects.title: Mini Project: Detecting Exoplanets Using TESS

details.description: Developed a Python program that interprets a star's TPF(Target Pixel File) from the datasets obtained using TESS (Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite) and generates a graph plotting the star's brightness which indicates the presence or absence of planets. This method of analysing if a star has planets based on its change in brightness (light curve) is called Transit Photometry.

projects.title: Real Time Video Based Vehicle Detection, Counting and Classification System

details.description: The goal of this research is to develop a vision-based vehicle counting and classification system. This system captures frames from video to undertake feature extraction in ability to detect and count the vehicles. It then classifies the vehicles by comparing the contour areas to the assumed values. The substantial contribution of the work is the comparison of two classification methods. Classification has been implemented using Contour Comparison (CC) as well as Bag of Features (BoF) method.
